TLDRH.quote: This pattern is consistent with either automated testing/seeding followed by cleanup, or a targeted spam/vandalism campaign that was subsequently removed.
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away thinking an unexplained bot-seeding or spam/vandalism campaign hit a wiki and was cleaned up by a moderator, with the correct dates and volumes but no idea who was behind it or why. Nothing of the actual account survives — no AI agents, no OpenAI, no timed lookup task, no collusion, no GET-based writing or admin impersonation — and the two hypotheses offered point the reader toward a spam attack, a wrong turn only partly mitigated by hedging.
